purpose: Canonical non-UI rules for the VAYQUO optimizer. Live cash prices and live award prices must come from approved providers; this file must never invent availability or award pricing.

passengers.reason: Award rules can depend on passenger age and seat requirement.

programSelection.rule: Do not require the user to select a loyalty program before search.

membershipRewards.optimizerAction: recommend only; user completes transfer with provider

pathPolicies.reason: Official BA Avios transfer between linked BA and Qatar accounts is immediate; this path can be more efficient than direct MR->Qatar and must be evaluated.
Official Avios transfer between linked BA and Iberia accounts is immediate.
Official Avios transfer between linked BA and Finnair accounts is immediate and Finnair documents 1:1.
MR->PAYBACK and PAYBACK->Miles & More are individually official, but VAYQUO will not recommend the chained path until source-of-points eligibility is explicitly confirmed.

paybackCashValue.rule: When recommending PAYBACK->Miles & More, compare against PAYBACK's guaranteed 1 cent per point opportunity value.

amexTravelPayWithPoints.rule: American Express Travel permits points payment for eligible travel, but the applicable EUR-to-MR conversion rate is dynamic/provider-defined and must not be hardcoded without a current quote.

awardPricing.otherPartners: use live provider result or current official award chart; never infer a live price from an old table
awardPricing.cashCopay: taxes, fees and airline surcharges are separate and must be included

excluded: other reduced award specials where excluded

mileagePooling.rule: Do not assume pooled miles. Only include pooled balance when the user explicitly indicates an active pool and accessible balance.

amexPlatinumOnlineTravelCreditDE.optimizerRule: Never subtract this credit from a generic Nuitee/Duffel cash price. Only compare it when the same acceptable itinerary has a confirmed eligible Amex Travel price and the user's credit is still unused.

sameItineraryComparison.rule: Do not call two options equivalent when material fare conditions differ.

awardAlternativeComparison.rule: Award flights at different times or on different airlines may be recommended as alternatives, but must be labelled as alternatives rather than the same flight.
awardAlternativeComparison.timeWindow: configurable; no hardcoded product-wide tolerance yet

transferMath.rounding: Round required source points up to the transfer step and respect the minimum transfer.
transferMath.excessTransferredBalance: Show any target points left after booking as remaining balance; do not pretend they were consumed by the booking.
transferMath.transferTimeRisk: Longer transfer times must create a visible availability-risk warning; do not invent a numeric penalty without evidence.

valuationRules.headlineDecision: Compare real cash outlay, live award cash copay, points actually consumed, eligible credits and material fare differences. Never use a user-entered 1-cent threshold as the normal decision engine.

mixedCurrencyPolicy.rule: If existing target-program miles plus transferred source points are both consumed, never divide the full cash saving only by the newly transferred source points.
show: cash saving before assigning point opportunity cost
mixedCurrencyPolicy.sourcePointValue: Only show a source-point value when the attribution is mathematically defensible; otherwise explain the mixed-balance structure.

valuationRules.paybackOpportunityCost: Treat each PAYBACK point used/transferred as having at least a 1 cent alternative redemption value.

cashBookingEarnings.rule: Future miles/MR earned on a cash ticket may be considered only when reliably calculable from booking channel, fare/ticket data, card and status. Never guess them.

temporaryTransferBonuses.rule: Promotional transfer bonuses must have explicit validity dates and source verification; never bake them into the base ratio.

mustHave: live or clearly timestamped award availability
number of award seats where available
EUR support or reliable original-currency data
awardProviderRequirements.passengerRequirement: Must support the passenger types VAYQUO intends to recommend. If children/infants are unsupported, adult-only search may not be presented as a complete family recommendation.

currentCandidateNotes.AwardWallet: Technically suitable result model, but provider support is dynamic via /providers/list and current docs support adults only. Miles & More availability/pricing and commercial terms must be confirmed before integration.
currentCandidateNotes.AwardTool: Enterprise real-time API advertises normalized points, fees, cabin, segments and known seat availability; exact VAYQUO program coverage and pricing must be confirmed before integration.

openQuestions.question: Can PAYBACK points originating from an MR->PAYBACK transfer always be converted onward to Miles & More under current rules?
Which commercial award provider currently supports Miles & More live award search, including mileage price, taxes/fees and seat availability?
Which selected award provider supports children/infants or otherwise provides enough data to apply current family award rules safely?
